hypothesis: Calibrate both causal-vs-best-null evidence AND nuisance-change-vs-unchanged evidence on an independent stable-only calibration set to reduce stable-model overfitting without sacrificing causal recall, nuisance-shock handling or strong conventional estimation margin.

frozen_method.calibration: 4096 stable-only authored fresh worlds; compute original P48 99th-percentile causal-vs-best-null BIC margin and a 99th-percentile maximum nuisance-change-vs-unchanged BIC margin, using numpy quantile(method='higher') with no eval observations or labels
frozen_method.selection: Keep original P48 causal selection as-is using calibration-seeded causal threshold. For noncausal worlds, select the original best nuisance-change effect ONLY if its BIC improvement vs unchanged model exceeds max(0, precomputed nuisance threshold); otherwise use original P47 unchanged-world full-window effect. Do not tune or change P47 BIC or fitted hypotheses.
frozen_method.other_controls: Unmodified P47 and P48, full-window conventional regression, nuisance-only best fit, recency-weighted, trailing-five, last-five contrast, ABA
frozen_method.strong_baseline: Compare stable MAE to unmodified full-window; also require no >10% loss in nuisance effect MAE versus P48 to expose over-conservative nuisance rejection
frozen_method.training: No optimizer, pretrained weights, neural training or hidden true-world labels passed to estimator
frozen_method.source_first_use: Local authored synthetic DEV only, no original external/science source first-use
frozen_method.matched_information: All arms receive exactly same eight completed alternating executed-action/observed-outcome events; hidden world kind/effect only used in final scoring
frozen_method.cold_restore: bit-exact from source factual actions, outcomes and two frozen scalar thresholds

source.actions: start sign random +/-1; alternate exactly eight completed actions

stop_rules: Do not adjust calibration quantile, seed, type, loss, source or acceptance criteria after first new evaluation; report original negative outcomes even if improved. Source is authored and therefore not independent scientific validation.
